package.name: rover_navigation
package.description: Module 5 of the Caterpillar Autonomy Challenge stack: the obstacle map built from live camera perception, A* planning on an inflated costmap, a pure pursuit controller with an in-place turn phase for the skid-steer, an exact rotated-rectangle footprint test for goals and in-place turns, a velocity gate that is the single writer of /cmd_vel (e-stop, command staleness, localisation gating, reactive brake), and the arena-level behaviour sequencer that drives /perception/mode (acquire, dig, haul, dump, park). The excavation mechanism itself is module 6, behind the WorkCycle action.
